tasks.title: Chat repository layer
tasks.description: Create ChatRepository: getChannels, getDirectMessages, getMessages, sendMessage, getThread, sendThreadReply, addReaction, removeReaction. Newest-first ordering for inverted list.
acceptanceCriteria: getMessages returns { items, nextCursor, hasMore } newest-first
sendMessage returns created message DTO for optimistic update
Handles 403 gracefully when user removed from channel

tasks.title: Chat TanStack Query hooks
tasks.description: Query hooks: useChannels, useMessages (infinite inverted), useThread. Mutation hooks: useSendMessage (optimistic), useSendThreadReply, useToggleReaction. Messages staleTime 10s, channels 60s.
acceptanceCriteria: useSendMessage optimistically adds message before server confirms
Failed send rolls back optimistic message and shows error
useMessages infinite query loads older messages on scroll up

tasks.title: Chat Zustand store
tasks.description: Create useChatStore: unreadCounts map, draftMessages map, activeChannelId. In-memory only drafts. Unread counts for tab badge and channel indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: setUnreadCount(channelId, 5) makes badge show 5 on that row
saveDraft preserves text when navigating away and back
clearUnread zeroes count when user opens the channel

tasks.title: Chat route group
tasks.description: Create chat/ route group with Stack navigator. Tab entry already exists from tracker phase. Wire unread badge from useChatStore into existing tab config.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat tab shows message icon with unread badge when count > 0
Badge disappears when all channels read
Tab navigation preserves each stack's navigation state

tasks.title: Channel list screen
tasks.description: SectionList: Channels and Direct Messages sections. Each row: name, last message preview, timestamp, unread indicator. Sorted by last activity. Pull-to-refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Channels and DMs render in separate sections with headers
Unread channels show bold title + blue dot; read shows normal
Pull-to-refresh re-fetches and updates unread indicators

tasks.title: Channel detail / message thread screen
tasks.description: Inverted FlashList messages. MessageBubble: avatar, name, text, timestamp, reactions, reply count. MessageInput with keyboard-avoiding. Mark read on mount. Long-press for reactions.
acceptanceCriteria: New messages appear at bottom without scroll jump
Keyboard opening pushes input and messages smoothly
Long-press shows emoji reaction sheet; tapping calls useToggleReaction

tasks.title: Thread replies screen
tasks.description: Thread view: parent message pinned at top, replies below. Reuses MessageBubble and MessageInput. useSendThreadReply mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Parent message pinned at top with visual distinction
Replies render chronologically below parent
Back to channel shows updated reply count on parent

tasks.title: Emoji reaction picker
tasks.description: Bottom sheet with 8 quick reactions + more. ReactionPills component below messages. Toggle behavior. Haptic feedback. Optimistic count update.
acceptanceCriteria: Quick grid shows 8 emojis; tapping adds reaction and dismisses
Tapping own reaction pill removes it (toggle)
Count updates optimistically before server confirmation
